cases.question: Two trains are moving in the same direction at 36 km/h and 72 km/h. Their lengths are 100 m and 200 m respectively. In how many seconds will the faster train pass the slower train?
Two trains are moving in the same direction at 36 km/h and 72 km/h. Their lengths are 100 m and 200 m respectively. In how many seconds will the slower train pass the faster train?

finding: Candidate discards which speed-ranked body is the passing subject. Same-direction overtaking interpretation requires the faster body as passer; the slower-subject wording should not be given the identical result without resolving this contradiction/ambiguity.
